src: yellow pixels in each row/column lane on one side of the full teal divider bar
path: straight orthogonal path from the nearest yellow pixel to the divider, then along the same lane on the opposite side to the far grid edge
trajectory: paint yellow up to the divider and teal after the divider
transform: original yellow pixels become green; in each processed lane, keep the input red-pixel count but pack those red pixels against the far edge; lanes without yellow remain unchanged
